problems: Elenchus prints only six column numbers (607, 611, 611, 621, 907, 1155) in a detached block for 21 titles; columns for the rest come from the Ordo and the body (colStatus body-only). The six assignments are inferred.

The 163 letters of Nicolaus are listed in the Ordo with columns, many damaged by OCR; they are given as parts with ordoCol exactly as read (e.g. '1358' for letter XXI, '23239' for XLVIII, '25' for XLIX). Letters 88, 89, 90, 95 and 96 have lost titles or columns in the OCR. Parts were not body-confirmed.

Ordo-only editorial items not entered: Moses bar-Cepha's Notitia (479) and 'Lectori Andreas Masius' (481); Seldeni Praefatio (889) and Echellensis Praefatio (895) to Eutychius; the Indices to Eutychius (Chronologiae Eutychianae Synopsis, Index rerum et verborum 1171, Topographicus 1181, Fluviorum et Montium 1193, Personarum 1193); the Index of authorities at the end of the Nicolaus section.

Page numbers in this OCR are often split across lines or lost; where a header gave only the right-hand (even) number the odd left column is recorded (Basilius Neopatrensis 411|412). Several title blocks sit at the foot of a page and the lists cite the next page (Josephus Genesius, Moses bar-Cepha, Nicephorus); recorded as the lists give them when the next header supports it.
The Georgius Monachus crossref sits after the end of Eutychius's Annales on page 1157, not 1155 as both lists read.
Greek flag is an automatic OCR count over 70 lines from the head; recheck at the plate before queue decisions.
The 'Praefatio' entry is Angelo Mai's Notitia and Monitum; the body shows no piece titled Praefatio (the word is the running head of cols 11-26).
